maps.design_caveat: Central control and exit congestion can favor particular approaches.
maps.design_purpose: Shared commons; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_commons_shared_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Matched supply with the spread sibling produces a readable renewable contest and many successful splits; actual income and overlap recur on the second layout. Early-contact acceleration is not stable across layouts, so that hypothesis is NOT promoted. A Valjean side sweep and orientation sensitivity remain caveats.
maps.score_rationale: Readable shared supply with broad gates and fallback food; a conservative extension of renewable reference maps.
maps.title: Shared commons

maps.design_caveat: Distributed harvesting need not lead to reliable late crown conversion.
maps.design_purpose: Spread commons; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_commons_spread_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Matched supply and shore with the shared sibling produce sustained local income, much longer games and meaningful late positions in both layouts. Two primary side-swapped pairs favor A; the second layout and reflection do not reproduce a universal side advantage. Retain with limited fairness evidence and exclude flagged no-action games from training.
maps.score_rationale: The same resource schedule is spread into multiple viable farming areas, giving a clear distribution contrast.
maps.title: Spread commons

maps.design_caveat: Prior side and orientation sensitivity remains unresolved.
maps.design_purpose: Overland causeway; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_causeway_detour_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Quarantined matched control: A wins all six direct games across three side-swapped opponent pairs, while its second layout and horizontal reflection favor B. This triggers the frozen practical bias warning. Keep for diagnosing initiative/geometry sensitivity; no default training weight.
maps.score_rationale: A coherent divider and several overland passages create meaningful route choices.
maps.title: Overland causeway

maps.design_caveat: Shortcut benefit is established structurally; safe commitment remains policy dependent.
maps.design_purpose: Portal causeway; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_causeway_portal_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: All portal pairs carry real traffic; the shortcut saves 11.524 mean terrain steps from initial heads to beds and ordinary alternatives remain. Each direct opponent beats Fafnir on both sides, including the held-back policy; the same screening winners recur on the second layout and reflection. This supports comparable opportunity, not a 50:50 target or proof of portal-memory activation.
maps.score_rationale: Useful paired shortcuts coexist with ordinary routes and food on both sides.
maps.title: Portal causeway

maps.design_caveat: One-cell exits can congest; prior side sensitivity lowers confidence in balance, not design coherence.
maps.design_purpose: Narrow orchard; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_orchard_narrow_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Productive rooms and repeated entrance/exit traffic are confirmed on both layouts. Fairness/robustness remains below the 4/5 inclusion requirement: strong side sweeps recur in sibling/reflection controls. The reflected pair spans 107 and 500 rounds and the narrow second layout is an A sweep. Retain as a provisional diagnostic control, not accepted training material.
maps.score_rationale: Productive rooms each have two distinct exits and an open exterior.
maps.title: Narrow orchard

maps.design_caveat: The old orientation and side results do not establish fair outcomes.
maps.design_purpose: Wide orchard; prior map card and full evidence retained in the preceding batch.
maps.name: md26_orchard_wide_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Productive rooms and repeated entrance/exit traffic are confirmed on both layouts. Fairness/robustness remains below the 4/5 inclusion requirement: strong side sweeps recur in sibling/reflection controls. One reflected game eliminates a side at round 33, versus 429–500 rounds on the primary. This is not an initial forced death, but the large sensitivity needs explanation. Retain as a provisional diagnostic control, not accepted training material.
maps.score_rationale: Wider room exits give readable escape and split space with the same productive footprint.
maps.title: Wide orchard

maps.design_caveat: This extends familiar ring geometry; its training value is not independently established.
maps.design_purpose: Structurally and visually vetted distinct ring grammar. No competitive games or outcomes read. Play behavior unverified.
maps.name: md26_promenade_ring_s0
maps.previous_balance_notes: Structurally and visually vetted distinct ring grammar. No competitive games or outcomes read. Play behavior unverified.
maps.score_rationale: Four openings connect an inner market with an outside route and distributed supply.
maps.title: Ring promenade

maps.design_caveat: Sealed interiors are intentional empty terrain; they must not be mistaken for missing rewards.
maps.design_purpose: Route around four deliberate sealed reefs to reach several harbors; interiors contain neither resources nor spawns.
maps.name: mc26_archipelago
maps.score_rationale: Four sealed reefs create understandable detours between accessible harbor resources.
maps.title: Reef archipelago

maps.design_caveat: Several rooms share one visual grammar, so this is related to the orchard family.
maps.design_purpose: Four porous resource districts connect through a broad cross-shaped junction and an outer route.
maps.name: mc26_crossroads
maps.score_rationale: Porous districts, a central junction and an outer route offer contest, retreat and flanking.
maps.title: Four-district crossroads

maps.design_caveat: Long bodies can still congest the turns; the first closed-basin draft was repaired before play.
maps.design_purpose: Two mirrored bent walls create longer sheltered approaches and a contested inner turn without a closed trap.
maps.name: mc26_pinwheel
maps.score_rationale: Bent shelves, broad openings and interior food support sheltered and direct approaches.
maps.title: Winding shelves

maps.design_caveat: A repeated band is more stylized than natural basins; wrapping is not itself strategic novelty.
maps.design_purpose: A renewable belt wraps across the horizontal seam, with staggered openings from the outer water.
maps.name: mc26_equatorial_belt
maps.score_rationale: A continuous food belt and staggered gates make both wrapping and access choice purposeful.
maps.title: Wrapped resource belt

maps.design_caveat: Boundary awareness may dominate weak navigation policies; the visual center is misleading by design.
maps.design_purpose: On a wide horizontal cylinder, meaningful food and contact lie across the wrap seam rather than the visual centre.
maps.name: mc26_seam_market
maps.score_rationale: Food near the horizontal seam makes short contact on a wide map meaningful.
maps.title: Seam market

maps.design_caveat: Mandatory portals are the strongest extrapolation here and can magnify policy paralysis or congestion.
maps.design_purpose: Four sealed districts connect in a portal ring; each district has two separate portal links. All productive regions are portal-reachable.
maps.name: mc26_portal_quartet
maps.score_rationale: A four-room ring has two distinct links per room and no unreachable active resources.
maps.title: Portal quartet

maps.design_caveat: Four portal pairs add complexity; useful memory or calibrated risk-taking is not proven by crossing counts.
maps.design_purpose: Four paired horizontal and vertical links shorten travel between remote depots, with open-water alternatives everywhere.
maps.name: mc26_relay_depots
maps.score_rationale: Multiple shortcuts connect remote food depots while ordinary travel remains possible.
maps.title: Relay depots

maps.design_caveat: The 70–110 gap applies to every renewal, not a scripted phase change; late supply may be underused.
maps.design_purpose: Small near-side farms supply the opening; the rich interior first becomes available after 70–110 ticks and keeps that renewal range.
maps.name: mc26_delayed_commons
maps.score_rationale: Opening farms sustain play before the large interior supply begins renewing.
maps.title: Delayed commons

maps.design_caveat: Synchronized timing is deliberately stylized and unusually sensitive to harvesting and occupancy.
maps.design_purpose: Fixed 12- and 36-tick bed schedules create predictable harvest pulses around porous shelves. These are recurring waves, not depleting food.
maps.name: mc26_pulse_farms
maps.score_rationale: Two fixed schedules create legible recurring harvest opportunities around porous shelves.
maps.title: Pulse farms

maps.design_caveat: A small number of wells may concentrate conflict; nominal output can greatly exceed realized income.
maps.design_purpose: A few every-round wells compete with slower fallback farms; open approaches make occupation and collector throughput important.
maps.name: mc26_spring_wells
maps.score_rationale: A few rapid wells and slower fallback farms support a clear occupation-versus-coverage choice.
maps.title: Spring wells

maps.design_caveat: This is a recombination of established large-map and distributed-income ideas, not a wholly new mechanic.
maps.design_purpose: Six starting dragons explore several separated harbors in a broad sea; modest departure supply supports the trip.
maps.name: mc26_far_harbors
maps.score_rationale: Six starts, departure food and separated harbors give a coherent larger navigation problem.
maps.title: Far harbors

maps.design_caveat: Interleaved deployment is a stronger extrapolation and can create strong opening-policy interactions.
maps.design_purpose: Each team starts in separated sectors, including a forward group near opposing territory; area is decoupled from local contact.
maps.name: mc26_scattered_fleets
maps.score_rationale: Mirrored forward groups and rear groups create multiple local fronts on a larger map.
maps.title: Scattered fleets

maps.design_caveat: Long starts already exist in references; this tests a new deployment/room combination rather than a new rule.
maps.design_purpose: One length-eight dragon per side starts in a spacious two-exit bay, allowing meaningful choices between early division and keeping mass.
maps.name: mc26_nursery_bays
maps.score_rationale: Length-eight starts have spacious bays and two broad exits, making early division plausible.
maps.title: Nursery bays

weighting_policy.game_weight: divide each map weight across its selected usable fixtures; never weight by fixture count

path_base: Directory containing this manifest; maps are directly alongside it.
